Curly Blow Dry
Training.

Build the foundations for confident, considered blow-dry work — from preparation and consultation through to the finished style.

The course outline brings together professional practice, hair knowledge and three distinct finishes. Practical case studies give you a way to put the learning into practice.

Good questions

Before you
take the next step.

Can I try the course before enquiring?

Yes. The student account demonstration lets you explore lessons, watch an example welcome video, download a workbook, try a knowledge check and submit example case studies. Switch to the tutor account to add material and review work. These are sample accounts, not real enrolments.

Who is the course for?

Tell Pippin about your current experience and what you’d like to learn. She can confirm the entry requirements and whether the course is the right fit.

What does the course cost?

Please enquire for confirmed course fees, any kit requirements, payment options and access terms.

Will I receive a certificate?

Ask Pippin to confirm the course’s accreditation, assessment requirements and certificate arrangements before you enrol.

Are the full videos and assessments available in the preview?

The account demonstration includes an example welcome video, sample lesson notes and a simulated assessment and feedback process. The approved teaching videos, formal assessment criteria and accreditation arrangements will be confirmed before enrolment.
